name: Wicked Rouge REFINE
source:
The city of Hana is built on shattered dreams and broken hearts. It is a city of passion, a city of vice, and its pleasure houses are the finest in all the land. And after your father's death, you find yourself in charge of his failing establishment, once one of the most prestigious of those renowned pleasure houses.

Can you avenge your father's murder? Can you restore "The Red Petal" to its former glory? And can you navigate your way through the intrigues of the pleasure capital's underworld without falling into the clutches of temptation?

Only time will tell...

A tale of sex and revenge awaits you. Engage in torrid flings with beautiful heroines, recruit oiran to work in your pleasure house, and do everything you can to keep your girls from falling into enemy hands.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/fidless]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
花之城，建立在破碎的梦想与伤透的心之上。这是一座激情之城，也是一座罪恶之城，拥有全国最顶尖的风月场所。父亲去世后，你接手了他经营不善的店铺，而这里，曾是这些著名风月场所中最负盛名的一家。

你能为遭人杀害的父亲复仇吗？能让“红花瓣”重现昔日荣光吗？又能否在这座情欲之都地下世界的阴谋之中，找到出路，避开诱惑的魔掌？

唯有时间能够给出答案……

一段关于性爱与复仇的故事，正等待着你。与美丽的女主角们展开炽热恋情，招募花魁为店铺工作，并竭尽所能，防止姑娘们落入敌人之手。
